format: WSDC competitor skill-level Jack and Jill limit

source.quote_free_summary: A competitor may compete in at most two skill-level WSDC Jack and Jill competitions, once in the primary role and once in the secondary role.

requirement: A future WSDC profile must enforce the per-competitor limit.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED.  DanceFlow does not verify or fulfill it; it remains the organizer's responsibility (R-14) unless DanceFlow explicitly implements and verifies it in a future body profile. It must not block eligible Studio/Custom competitions.
interpretation_notes: WSDC: effective_from 2026-01-17 is taken from the file name (Updated Jan17 2026); the footers read Version 2026.1C and the file name says 2026.1B (registry note). Re-read 2026-11-24. This limits a competitor's entries, not a contest's size. DanceFlow does not enforce it. BLOCKER for a WSDC profile.
